name: Marcus Chen
psychographics: Values efficiency and data-driven solutions; hates wasting time on tasks that feel manual. Believes systems should adapt to humans, not the reverse.
current_solutions: Co-Homemade meal-kit subscription (modified for gluten-free) and Paprika recipe manager for manual input of safe recipes.
frustration: Spent 20 minutes at 6:45 PM last Tuesday searching the pantry for the gluten-free pasta, only to realize the kids had eaten the last serving at lunch; had to call the babysitter to bring emergency mac and cheese from the corner store.
decision_style: reads reviews for weeks, then buys the highest-rated option on Amazon, often regretting not trying local alternatives sooner.
voice: Blunt and direct; uses technical jargon like "workflow" and "integration" when describing daily life; speaks in short, clipped sentences when stressed.
